race.description: Tristan Triffitt Exclusive Estate Agents Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: SEVEN DAYS (9) started at $1.50 but had no luck in the straight and should be forgiven her last start fifth over 1100m at Wyong. Savaged the line the run prior over 1100m so getting out to this trip with a long run home looks the perfect scenario at the fourth run back. ME ME (10) is back after a 15-week spell. Good fresh performer with a win and two placings from four attempts. Trialling well so from a nice gate a bright return looks on the cards. DENIAL (6) has worked home well without threatening in two runs this prep, the latest over today's distance on the Illawarra Grange circuit. Should be peaking at this stage of the campaign. EQUILIBRIST (4) has been a bit out of sorts but his record of three wins from six tries at this track and distance keeps him under notice. STAKEHOLDER (5) failed in town last start after a strong maiden win over this track and trip first-up. Can make amends.
